summary: Multi-tenant template query isolation successfully enforced. Users can only access global templates and their organization's templates. Cross-org template leaks prevented.

instructionalState.requirement: Activity templates must be filtered by organization scope during query operations
instructionalState.securityGoal: Prevent users from accessing templates belonging to other organizations
instructionalState.compliance: OWASP A01:2021 - Broken Access Control mitigation

functionalState.mechanism: Extract org_id from Bearer token, filter templates by scope and org_id match
functionalState.securityBoundary: Database WHERE clause prevents unauthorized data from entering system

verification.method: Validation harness with 5 test cases covering org isolation, unauthenticated access, and global visibility
evidence: Test 2 PASS: User 2 cannot see User 1's org templates
Test 4 PASS: Unauthenticated users see only global templates

trace.findings: Identified 3 components needing modification (route, action, database layers)
trace.dataFlow: GET /templates → list_activity_templates → list_templates → list_all_templates → SurrealDB query
gaps: Route layer: Missing org_id extraction from Bearer token
Action layer: Missing scope filtering for cached templates
Database layer: Missing WHERE clause for org_id filtering

remainingIssues: Response serialization doesn't include scope/org_id fields (non-security issue)

remainingWork: Rebuild Docker image (code in submodule, not yet in container)

relatedSpecs.note: Part 1 creates scope fields, Part 2 (this spec) uses them for filtering

gitCommit.message: feat(activity-template-query-filtering): Enforce multi-tenant template query isolation

before.issue: All users could access all templates regardless of organization
before.impact: Cross-org data leakage, exposure of proprietary workflows

after.enforcement: Users can only access global templates + their org's templates
after.validation: Cross-org isolation verified via Test 2 (User 2 cannot see User 1's templates)

securityPosture.improvement: Multi-tenant isolation enforced at 3 layers (route, action, database)
